name: mid-apocalyptic c (support🇨🇦🇲🇽🇪🇺🇳🇴🇫🇷🇬🇱)
text:
For the #atx #austin area folks:
Wow.
It's the first day of early voting and I was amazed to see that the line in Mueller at 6pm was like a block long (thankfully indoors). I have never seen this kind of turnout on day one, and I have lived here forever.
Everyone, please vote!
